The '''rings of Geonosis'''<ref name="Slave I">{{SWE|technology|slavei|''Slave I''}}</ref> were a set of [[planetary ring]]s that [[orbit]]ed the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. They were created when a two [[kilometer]]-wide [[comet]] collided with one of Geonosis' [[moon]]lets.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The rings' [[asteroid]]s were mined for raw materials to construct the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]].<ref name="Updated and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>
